meta.name: First Copy
meta.description: In the heart of Mumbai during the 1990s, 'Arif,' a notorious and desperately romantic figure, rises to infamy as the kingpin of film piracy. As he weaves an intricate web of distribution, his audacious exploits attract the attention of law enforcement, Bollywood celebrities, and the criminal underworld, leading to a thrilling cat-and-mouse chase.

videos.title: The Pirate Returns
videos.overview: Out of jail and full of charm, Arif hustles fake Walkmans to restore his dignity, but a clash with his brother-in-law pushes him toward a tough promise to go straight or lose respect.

videos.title: Chai, Toast & Insults
videos.overview: Arif takes up a job at a film office to please his father, but after a petty humiliation by producer Mahesh Kumar, he vows quiet revenge with a projector and perfect timing.

videos.title: The Reel
videos.overview: Arif partners with Pravin and Rajnish to burn their first pirated VCD before the film even hits theatres kickstarting a bold new empire built on entertainment and deception.

videos.title: Chawl Cinema
videos.overview: As Arif's piracy spreads joy in chawls and fear in the industry, Mani becomes the face of the first-day-first-show culture, while Mahesh smells trouble and calls in the cops.

videos.title: Chore Police
videos.overview: Sanjay Gogoi, a passionate cop with nothing to lose, is assigned to the piracy case. Meanwhile, Arif's rising fame puts him on Mahesh's radar and Mona gets closer to Arif.

videos.title: The X Mark
videos.overview: With demand rising, Arif and Pravin strike a massive deal with a major CD wholesaler, but Inspector Sanjay has already set up a trap. As the frames reveal the mark, Arif finds himself exposed and Rajnish's fate takes an unexpected turn.

videos.title: Uncensored Reels
videos.overview: Arif meets Rajnish in Jail, worried after losing his main source for reels, he finds a different route in Afreen's words. As the relation with Mona grows, cracks form at home with Afreen, while Sanjay tightens the net with a fearless new ally in Ragini.

videos.title: The Back Door
videos.overview: Missing the Niyaz and breaking Afreen's trust, Arif returns with a stolen reel and a risky idea: a pirated copy. With Praveen by his side and names in hand, he dives into a game and takes one step back to restart his piracy business.

videos.title: The Network
videos.overview: As Aisha's film rolls, Mona confronts Mahesh Kumar. As Mahesh's films start leaking again, he cracks down hard and Sanjay's police raid dents the piracy business until Arif finds a new delivery trick inspired by Afreen's biryani, VCDs hidden in plain sight, spreading even as the walls close in.

videos.title: Catch The Pirate
videos.overview: As distance grows between Arif and Praveen, Aisha's film leak leads Sanjay and Ragini straight to the source ending with Arif in handcuffs and the empire in peril.

videos.title: Crossroads
videos.overview: Arif returns with swagger but a brushing clash with Mahesh Kumar inside the jail puts his pride, peace and future on the line.

videos.title: A New Era
videos.overview: As Pravin fuels Guru’s empire, Mahesh Kumar strikes back at Arif’s rise, leaving him with an ultimatum he can’t outrun.

videos.title: Don't Look Back
videos.overview: Arif juggles between new alliances and old romances while Sanjay tightens his grip over the new racket in town.

videos.title: Magnum Opus
videos.overview: As tension erupts between Pravin and Guru, and Mahesh sparks a revolution in the film industry, Arif is about to witness a life-changing Homecoming.

videos.title: Departure
videos.overview: Arif enjoys his new life but an unexpected arrival of a new enemy brings his life to square one.

videos.title: Door To Hell
videos.overview: Ahead of Ragini’s book release, Sanjay finds falters in their trust as they clash over her independent journalism while Arif takes a daring step to expand his empire.

videos.title: A New Route
videos.overview: Arif risks everything to meet the underworld don, Rajan for scaling up his piracy game while Afreen finds her own path at home as loyalty and danger tests their relationship.

videos.title: Naya Nasha
videos.overview: Arif’s double romance comes crashing down leaving him with only one option, meanwhile his piracy empire aims for a bigger market, a bigger network.

videos.title: Operation Rajan
videos.overview: In the midst of Rajan’s arrival to India, Sanjay prepares for a covert operation. Meanwhile Arif makes a final decision between love and loyalty.

videos.title: Mumkin Hai
videos.overview: Burdened life brings Mani and Arif together, with a choice to upend his life for good Arif makes his final attempt to go bigger than he ever was.
